receipt_export_rule: Allow only the ProviderUsageReceipt scalar schema; reject prompts, HTML, OCR text, source URLs/paths, headers, request IDs, exception bodies, and credentials.
selection_rule: Before a live run, choose exactly the hostname that belongs to the explicitly approved configured provider; block all others.
kill_conditions: Immediately cancel if a receipt reports cost at or above 80 percent of the per-job ceiling.
Immediately cancel if a job's critical-path observation approaches either configured timeout without terminal progress.
Immediately cancel on hostname-allowlist violation, receipt privacy validation failure, or repeated retry amplification above 1.25.
After cancellation, preserve only safe aggregate receipts and terminal state; do not capture request/response bodies.
dry_run_command: cd servers/fastapi; uv run python scripts/provider_usage_benchmark.py --synthetic-fixture ../../docs/experiments/authored-vnext/01-generation-baseline/provider_usage_offline_fixture_v1.json --output ../../docs/experiments/authored-vnext/01-generation-baseline/runs/provider-usage-offline-90x3.json
